revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 4.3%, FY23-25 revenue CAGR ~0.4%; modest cyclical recovery/backlog and pricing fading toward GDP-plus growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 16.5% (11151/67589), FY2023-24 about 19.4-20.2%; midpoint-ish allowing for tariff cost pressure and partial recovery.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. US federal 21% plus state/foreign mix; Damodaran Machinery effective rate 13.4% judged too low for CAT.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: between 3-yr average (~3.3%) and FY2025 4.2% (2821/67589), reflecting elevated investment in capacity; stays above D&A.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (UST 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.01 (Damodaran Machinery unlevered cash-corrected 0.894, D/E 0.147) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US) = Ke 9.4%; after-tax Kd 3.97% (Damodaran); weights 87.2/12.8 => ~8.7%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation-like growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived: LT debt 30,696 + short-term borrowings 5,514 - cash 9,980 (no ST investments); 10-K 0000018230-26-000008. Note: includes Financial Products debt.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted avg diluted shares 472,300,000, us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding, 10-K 0000018230-26-000008; in millions
